pageDescription: Monitor and control network activity on this device — see which apps are connecting where, scan for open ports, and check destinations against threat intelligence. On-device and metadata-only, never traffic contents.
dnsStopped: Stopped — start it to filter trackers/malware and encrypt DNS.
dnsPointHint: Point your OS or browser DNS to {{address}} to filter and encrypt all lookups.
enforceOn: Active — every app on this device now resolves through Bulwrk (filtered + encrypted). Auto-reverts as a safety backstop.
enforceOff: Route ALL system DNS through the resolver at {{address}} (not just apps you configure).
enforceWarn: Requires elevation. Backs up your DNS settings and restores them when disabled or on auto-revert.
rulesHint: Create allow/block rules. Block rules also feed the Secure DNS resolver's filter list. Rules override the automatic verdict on the Connections tab.
rulesPlaceholder: domain to block or allow, e.g. ads.example.com
rulesEmpty: No custom rules yet. Add one above.
rulesCountryPlaceholder: 2-letter country code, e.g. CN, RU, KP
geoipReady: GeoIP ready — {{count}} IP ranges. Country rules are active.
geoipNotReady: GeoIP database not downloaded yet — click Update to enable country rules.
noConnections: No active outbound connections right now.
scanHint: TCP connect scan (no root needed). Presets: 'top' for well-known ports, or ranges like 1-1024 and lists like 22,80,443. Defaults to this device (127.0.0.1).
noOpenPorts: No open ports found in the scanned range.
feedHint: JSON array of indicators (value, type: domain|ip|cidr, category). Prefilled with a labeled example set — replace with a real feed such as URLhaus, ThreatFox, or abuse.ch.
spnDescription: A multi-hop, onion-style encrypted network (inspired by Safing's SPN) that routes each app's traffic through independent relays so no single hop sees both who you are and where you're going. This requires dedicated relay infrastructure and a hardened tunnel client, so it is on the roadmap — not enabled yet. See docs/architecture for the design.
enableWizardConfirmBody: Start the local Secure DNS resolver on this device? Filter lists and Network Guard rules will apply to lookups that use this resolver.
enableWizardConfirmHint: This does not change system-wide DNS yet. Use Protect this device afterward if you want every app to route through Bulwrk.
enableWizardDoneBody: The local resolver is running. Update filter lists, then optionally enable Protect this device for system-wide coverage.
enforceWizardConfirmBody: Route all system DNS through Bulwrk’s local resolver? Previous DNS settings will be backed up.
enforceWizardConfirmHint: Requires elevation. Auto-reverts as a safety backstop. Disable anytime from this tab.
enforceWizardDoneBody: System DNS now goes through Bulwrk. Verify a few sites load, then Disable immediately if anything looks wrong.
